metadata.name: {FilesName}
metadata.description: Building the best file manager for Windows.

community.heading: Made in the open by the people who use it
community.intro: {FilesName} is open source. The code is on GitHub, where anyone can report issues, suggest ideas and contribute.
community.people_description: Every update is designed, built and translated by people like these.
community.discord_description: Talk with the team, share feedback and get help.
community.code_description: Build {FilesName} from source and open your first pull request.
community.translate_description: Bring {FilesName} to more people in their own language.
community.sponsor_description: Sponsorships on GitHub pay for the time that goes into every update. Even a small monthly amount helps keep {FilesName} growing.

hero.title: The file manager Windows deserves
hero.tagline: A cleaner, more modern way to browse your files, with tabs and tags when you need them. Use it alongside File Explorer for a better everyday experience.
hero.store_note: Open source. Your Store purchase funds development.
hero.screenshot_alt: {FilesName} with the Downloads folder in one pane and road trip photos in the other, with three tabs open

tour.title: Get more done with your files.
tour.description: Work in two folders at once, color-code what matters and find any command in the Omnibar.

dualpane.title: Dual pane
dualpane.description: Open two folders next to each other in one window, then drag files from one to the other.
dualpane.alt: {FilesName} with the Music folder in one pane and wallpapers in the other

tags.title: Color tags
tags.description: Mark files and folders with tags like Work or Photos. Click a tag in the sidebar to see everything that has it.
tags.alt: Files and folders with color tags in the Tag column

columns.title: Columns layout
columns.description: Each folder you open shows up in a new column next to the last one, so you can see the whole path at a glance.
columns.alt: Folders opened one per column in the columns layout

palette.title: Command palette
palette.description: Open it from the Omnibar and type what you want to do, like “dual pane” or “hidden items”. Every command has a shortcut you can change.
palette.alt: The command palette listing commands and their key bindings

git.title: Built-in Git
git.description: Inside a repository, see which files changed and each one's last commit, author and SHA. Switch branches, pull or push from the status bar.
git.alt: A Git repository showing commit message, author and commit SHA columns, with the branch list open

toolbar.title: Custom toolbar
toolbar.description: Put the commands you use most on the toolbar, like Copy path, and remove the ones you don't. Pick which ones show a label.
toolbar.alt: The Customize toolbar window with Copy path, Create zip archive and Split vertically added

extract.title: Smart extract
extract.description: Press Ctrl+Shift+E on an archive and {FilesName} picks where it goes. A single item lands right here, and many items get a new folder.
extract.alt: A zip file selected in Downloads with the toolbar's Extract menu open, Extract here (Smart) and its Ctrl+Shift+E shortcut highlighted

foldersizes.title: Folder sizes
foldersizes.description: See how big each folder is right in the file list. Click View size on one folder, or turn on folder sizes in Settings.
foldersizes.alt: The Videos folder with the size of every subfolder in the Size column

backgrounds.title: Custom backgrounds
backgrounds.description: Put your own picture behind {FilesName} and choose how it fits and how much shows through. You can also give a single folder its own background.
backgrounds.alt: Settings, Appearance with a photo set as the background image

reopen_tab.title: Reopen closed tabs
reopen_tab.description: Closed a tab by mistake? Press Ctrl+Shift+T to bring it back.

hashes.title: File hashes
hashes.description: Check a file's MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256 hash right in Properties.

shortcuts.title: Your own shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Change any keyboard shortcut, or give one to a command that has none.

compact_overlay.title: Compact overlay
compact_overlay.description: Keep a small {FilesName} window on top of your other apps.

go_up.title: Double-click to go up
go_up.description: Double-click an empty spot in a folder to go up one level.

sort_together.title: Sort files and folders together
sort_together.description: Mix folders in with your files instead of always listing them first.

filter.title: Filter a folder
filter.description: Press Ctrl+Shift+F and type part of a name to show only the items that match.

archives.title: Password-protected archives
archives.description: Protect a new 7z or ZIP file with a password, or split a 7z into smaller parts.

ide.title: Open in your code editor
ide.description: Open the current folder in VS Code or the editor you pick in Settings.

download.title: Get {FilesName} today.
download.description: It installs in seconds and runs alongside File Explorer, with the folders you already have. Nothing changes until you open it.
download.store_description: The easiest way to install {FilesName}, and the one that keeps the project going.

benefits.updates: New features and fixes install automatically
benefits.install: One click to install, one click to remove

download.title: Download {FilesName}
download.subtitle: {FilesName} is a community-driven project. Purchasing it on the Microsoft Store is the best way to support its development.

microsoft_store.description: Purchasing {FilesName} through the Microsoft Store helps support the developers and allows us to continue updating the app with new features and improvements.

preview.description: The preview version can be installed alongside the stable release and provides early access to new features and improvements.

classic_benefits.features: The same app as the Microsoft Store version
classic_benefits.updates: {FilesName} checks for new versions and updates in one click
classic_benefits.app_installer: Opens in App Installer, which comes with Windows

dialog.sponsor: This way is free. If {FilesName} is useful to you, please consider sponsoring the people who build it.

powershell.name: PowerShell
powershell.description: Run it in Windows PowerShell as administrator. PowerShell 7 won't work.

offline.name: Offline install
offline.description: Download these files and install them in the order listed.

requirements.message: Installing needs the Windows Update and Delivery Optimization services. Modified versions of Windows that remove them aren't supported.
